scope: Extends the one-field source-bound AC1027 MLEADERSTYLE transaction to group 341 arrowHeadBlockHandle, retargeted to one unique source BLOCK_RECORD with a complete block body. This qualifies only the selected group-341 profile; it makes no claim for group 343, other handle roles, native arrowhead meaning or full document support.

contract.admission: A runtime-authored AC1027 DXF contains one STANDARD MLEADERSTYLE whose existing group 341 identifies fixed Model_Space BLOCK_RECORD 0x1F, plus one unique alternate BLOCK_RECORD 0x21 named MLEADER_ALT_ARROW and a BLOCK/LINE/ENDBLK body owned by it. The caller changes only arrowHeadBlockHandle to that source provider. Existing graph validation must resolve the target to exactly one BLOCK_RECORD and its block body.
contract.output: The transaction authenticates original raw groups against the captured typed style, admits exactly one changed group-341 field, emits its remapped handle, and inspects the output through the source BLOCK_RECORD name-to-output mapping. Fresh import verifies exactly one raw group 341 names the emitted BLOCK_RECORD, typed arrowHeadBlockHandle resolves to that record, and the emitted record owns the complete block body.
contract.failureAndRetry: A dangling target 0x55 and a wrong-kind LTYPE target 0x30 refuse for ASCII and binary output. Each refusal preserves a pre-existing destination and the caller's invalid handle. Repairing the same caller object to BLOCK_RECORD 0x21 and retrying on the same dx_iface succeeds and passes output/readback checks.
contract.compatibility: No public API or DRW_Interface virtual changes. The ASCII/binary sources and converted outputs are generated and removed at runtime; no DWG/DXF fixtures are committed. Fixed Model_Space/Paper_Space names use the block-symbol normalization path when the shared MLEADERSTYLE raw-output inspector maps block references.
contract.limits: One AC1027 MLEADERSTYLE group-341 edit profile only. This does not qualify group 343, other versions, multiple edits, other block schemas, producer variation, native arrowhead semantics, complete document closure, external semantic evidence or 3D support. No support claim is promoted.

controls.referenceProof: Source group 341 begins at 0x1F; the unique alternate BLOCK_RECORD is 0x21 and owns the generated block body. Exact raw group-341 output and typed readback resolve to the remapped alternate BLOCK_RECORD handle.
controls.failureAndRetry: Dangling and wrong-kind targets each refuse for both output encodings; destination bytes and caller references are preserved, and corrected retries on the same adapter succeed.

focusedSelector.summary: 1/1 MLEADERSTYLE writer-closure selector passed. The group-341 transaction covers four source/output encoding combinations, exact raw and typed output/readback, an owned BLOCK/LINE/ENDBLK body, dangling and wrong-kind refusals, destination/caller preservation, and corrected same-adapter retries.
